'''Hans-Heinrich Voigt''' (18 April 1921<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.whoswho.de/bio/hans-heinrich-voigt.html|title = Hans-Heinrich Voigt - Biografie Who's WHO}}</ref> – 17 November 2017) was a German astronomer and director of the [[Göttingen Observatory]].<ref>{{cite web|title=History of the Universitäts-Sternwarte Göttingen|url=http://www.uni-sw.gwdg.de/institute/history/index.en.html|access-date=25 July 2013|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110930083352/http://www.uni-sw.gwdg.de/institute/history/index.en.html|archive-date=30 September 2011}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Literature by and about Hans-Heinrich Voigt in the catalog of the German National Library|url=https://portal.dnb.de/opac.htm?query=Woe%3D120221543&method=simpleSearch|accessdate=25 July 2013}}</ref>

Voigt was ordinary professor of astronomy at the [[University of Göttingen]] and directed the Göttingen Observatory from 1963 to 1986, when he retired.<ref>Information of University of Göttingen to his 80th birthday : [https://www.uni-goettingen.de/de/3240.html?archive=true&archive_source=presse&archive_id=306 Hans-Heinrich Voigt wird 80 - Festakt zum Geburtstag des renommierten Göttinger Astronomen]</ref><ref name=minplan /> He was a member of the [[Göttingen Academy of Sciences]] and its president from 1978 to 1979.<ref name=AdWProfile>{{cite web|title=Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen Profile|url=http://adw-goe.de/personenanzeige/?cHash=977701c45320c78e80d1a823aea3c1f3&tx_wtdirectory_pi1%5Bshow%5D=191|accessdate=25 July 2013|archive-date=25 July 2013|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130725032658/http://adw-goe.de/personenanzeige/?cHash=977701c45320c78e80d1a823aea3c1f3&tx_wtdirectory_pi1%5Bshow%5D=191|url-status=dead}}</ref>  In 1993 he received the [[Carl Friedrich Gauss Medal]].

He died on 17 November 2017 at the age of 96 in [[Göttingen]].<ref name=obituary>{{cite web|title=Astronom Voigt gestorben|url=http://www.goettinger-tageblatt.de/Mehr/Campus/Goettingen/Astronom-Voigt-gestorben|accessdate=25 November 2017}}</ref>
In 1988 an asteroid was named [[4378 Voigt]] after him.<ref name=minplan>{{cite book|last=Schmadel|first=Lutz|title=Dictionary of Minor Planet Names, Volume 1|date=2003|publisher=Springer|isbn=9783540002383|page=376}}</ref>

==Works==

* ''Outline of Astronomy'' (1974) <ref>{{cite book|last=Voigt|first=Hans-Heinrich|title=Outline of astronomy|date=1974|publisher=Noordhoff|location=Leyden|isbn=9789001712709}}</ref>
* ''Das Universum'' (1994) <ref>{{cite book|last=Voigt|first=Hans-Heinrich|title=Das Universum : Planeten - Sterne - Galaxien ; mit 8 Tabellen|date=1994|publisher=Reclam|location=Stuttgart|isbn=9783150052280}}</ref> 
* ''Abriß der Astronomie'' (2012) <ref>{{cite book|last=Voigt|first=Hrsg. Hermann J. Röser; Hrsg. Hans H.|title=Abriß der Astronomie|date=2009|publisher=WILEY-VCH|location=Weinheim, Bergstr|isbn=9783527407361|edition=6., wes. überarb. u. erw. Aufl.}}</ref>
